about: Inputs of tests/runtime/ribbon_scorecard.py: window widths, apps, the weights and floors of the plan, and the slot geometry the ribbon must keep. The banner slot is x = width - banner_right_gap, y = banner_y, 360 px wide, at every width >= compact_below; below it the banner must still show inside the window (compact banner). ribbon_height is the distance from the window top to the document tab row, measured on beta.5 (gtk3, vi_VN, scale 1).
